name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: A set of layered sections of content, known as tab panels, that are displayed one at a time.

<script setup lang="ts">
import { TabsRoot, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui';
import type { TabsRootEmits, TabsRootProps } from 'reka-ui';

const props = defineProps<TabsRootProps>();
const emits = defineEmits<TabsRootEmits>();

const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);
</script>

<template>
  <TabsRoot
    data-slot="tabs"
    v-bind="forwarded"
  >
    <slot />
  </TabsRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { TabsContent, type TabsContentProps } from 'reka-ui';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<TabsContentProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <TabsContent
    data-slot="tabs-content"
    v-bind="{ ...props, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    class="sigma-ui-tabs-content"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </TabsContent>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-tabs-content {
  margin-top: calc(var(--spacing) * 2);
}

.sigma-ui-tabs-content:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { TabsList, type TabsListProps } from 'reka-ui';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<TabsListProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <TabsList
    data-slot="tabs-list"
    v-bind="{ ...props, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    class="sigma-ui-tabs-list"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </TabsList>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-tabs-list {
  display: inline-flex;
  height: calc(var(--spacing) * 10);
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 2px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background-color: var(--muted);
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { TabsTrigger, type TabsTriggerProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<TabsTriggerProps>();

const forwardedProps = useForwardProps(props);
</script>

<template>
  <TabsTrigger
    data-slot="tabs-trigger"
    v-bind="{ ...forwardedProps, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    class="sigma-ui-tabs-trigger"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </TabsTrigger>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-tabs-trigger {
  display: inline-flex;
  height: 100%;
  flex: 1;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  padding-inline: calc(var(--spacing) * 3);
  transition-duration: 150ms;
  transition-property: all;
  transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.sigma-ui-tabs-trigger:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.sigma-ui-tabs-trigger:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.sigma-ui-tabs-trigger[data-state="active"] {
  background-color: var(--input);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 5%);
  color: var(--foreground);
}
</style>
